Chapter 3 · The unexpected ticket

What happened next?

Read Clara’s story and watch the lottery draw.

01 · Read & predict

Clara woke up the next morning…

Clara woke up the next morning and rubbed her eyes in disbelief. There, on her nightstand, was a lottery ticket. She hadn’t bought one, so how did it get there? Curious and a bit confused, she picked it up and decided to watch the lottery drawing on TV.

Before you press play: Do you think Clara will win?
02 · Watch

Did Clara win the lottery?

Watch the lottery drawing. Find out whether Clara wins, then examine her ticket and decide which of the five plays is the winning one.

Look closely at Clara’s ticket

There are five numbered plays on the ticket, from top to bottom. Which one matches the winning numbers?

1. Did Clara win?

2. Which play is the winner?

Count the plays from the top of the ticket.
